compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
Supporting documentation for DD3, DD4 — ensures new config keys are discoverable by downstream consumers

## Implementation

File: plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md (modify)

Add a new entry for `enforcement.strategy` (already implied by prior stories but now formally written by the installer):
- Key: enforcement.strategy
- Allowed values: local, ci, both
- Default: local
- Description: Controls whether validation gates run locally (in hooks/review-gate) or are delegated to CI

Update the existing `merge.strategy` entry to add a note:
- Default selection: create-dso-app.sh installer writes `direct` as initial default; /dso:onboarding Phase 3 may override with user's choice

## TDD Requirement
Static documentation file — no executable behavior. Non-executable instruction file exemption (behavioral-testing-standard.md: requires observable behavior; documentation does not have executable behavior).

Structural check only: grep for 'enforcement.strategy' and 'enforcement' in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md.
Verify: grep -q 'enforcement\.strategy' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] enforcement.strategy entry added to CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
  Verify: grep -q 'enforcement\.strategy' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] merge.strategy entry notes default-selection by installer
  Verify: grep -A5 'merge\.strategy' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md | grep -qi 'create-dso-app\|installer\|direct.*default'
- [ ] Lint and format pass
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
